draft.title: Taccuino del giorno · 19 ottobre 2026
draft.excerpt: Una giornata tra accuse arbitrali, scelte tecniche e spiragli di mercato per i talenti azzurri in circolazione.
draft.excerptEn: A day marked by refereeing controversies, tactical choices and market developments for Italy's young talent on loan.
draft.bodyIt:
**Cher Ndour**
Il difensore della Fiorentina punta il dito sulla direzione di gara e sulla possibile irregolarità nel primo gol subito, ma apprezza comunque la reazione della squadra. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQNHFqVWtfYjBPcWhKbVpmZ093eGJNdzVjVmtfMlFJNXRhVzVObmZXN1BSWER2aXIxSHBSUXk0aUxzbTFKa0lOV0hQY0FPOUppaTVTSERJeWJYU05USUw2MlM5VVFwS3paR251a2x2bWF1RHBSa0JSUFFVMHZibFdEakpmQjNBVml6TElpTjdmcDMyOW1JWUh3ZmFNZ0czR24tc3g5bVZPblZIUi0zQUhuNFZOWHQ?oc=5)

**Simone Pafundi**
L'attaccante del Verona in prestito non sarà della partita contro il Catanzaro, mentre l'allenatore Gorgone cambia modulo e deve decidere tra due portieri. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxQaVhBeHF1aHZKLXYtQW9EZ0NNMjY0dmczZ202ZnpGM3FnTFo0NHE0SWRWNnFZbG5CbG5mdTlZX0FWOWVNamhTYXpoc0w2d0ZNMHdnc0xwRHRQMUNzcGwtZzQ4enBBUElkdmFQckVOV0hwamFzRTU3RS02b3E3WEFTY1FsN3NYNkFoaDJSVW9rQjlMc0JaOVVn?oc=5)

**Dominic Vavassori**
Il giovane talento entra nel radar del Palermo e rappresenta una delle promesse su cui il club rosanero sta puntando. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOdHRvaWRieHpUNmdrUEFETUdiYUdQN0NHa1lFcms2d0NCXzRNdXBrUDdEWmRRalFiUUlKZ1FiWFEtQ2xvV3p1eTJGNkIzblp3VXlNNWtjS1dPTDJ5TDdVcmZVRXpGQlFKLTFqREtWcThCWTdtQmx3VDlCRzE0R3JjQnRYYUc3M2s?oc=5)

**Giuseppe Ambrosino**
La partenza dell'attaccante dal Napoli accende il dibattito: molti si chiedono se fosse davvero necessario privarsene sul mercato. [fonte](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Gabriel Kulla**
Il centrocampista del Sassuolo continua a sorprendere in Primavera e inizia a farsi notare per una possibile chiamata in Serie A, con possibili sviluppi di mercato già a gennaio. [fonte](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQNTI1ZzNNUGtBeThmV3g3U3BDNld3WXZNQ2RVakppV3BZLUlSOTBvREk0cndzQ1ZvdFBxUnI2dm8tMlVrSkY1VUZsR2ZKV3ZEU3owa1FzZjYtcV9aNXlHYm9xS3dObTNudUhZaGU4NVdsSWg5NVBaaFJZMmFvendmQ3VJUjN1Zw?oc=5)

Tra controversie arbitrali, assenze tecniche e speranze di rilancio: il giovane calcio italiano si muove tra le pieghe della quotidianità.
draft.bodyEn:
**Cher Ndour**
The Fiorentina defender points to the referee's decisions and a possible irregularity in the first goal conceded, though he appreciates the team's reaction nonetheless. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQNHFqVWtfYjBPcWhKbVpmZ093eGJNdzVjVmtfMlFJNXRhVzVObmZXN1BSWER2aXIxSHBSUXk0aUxzbTFKa0lOV0hQY0FPOUppaTVTSERJeWJYU05USUw2MlM5VVFwS3paR251a2x2bWF1RHBSa0JSUFFVMHZibFdEakpmQjNBVml6TElpTjdmcDMyOW1JWUh3ZmFNZ0czR24tc3g5bVZPblZIUi0zQUhuNFZOWHQ?oc=5)

**Simone Pafundi**
The Verona loanee will not feature against Catanzaro as manager Gorgone switches formation and faces a choice between two goalkeepers. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxQaVhBeHF1aHZKLXYtQW9EZ0NNMjY0dmczZ202ZnpGM3FnTFo0NHE0SWRWNnFZbG5CbG5mdTlZX0FWOWVNamhTYXpoc0w2d0ZNMHdnc0xwRHRQMUNzcGwtZzQ4enBBUElkdmFQckVOV0hwamFzRTU3RS02b3E3WEFTY1FsN3NYNkFoaDJSVW9rQjlMc0JaOVVn?oc=5)

**Dominic Vavassori**
The young prospect enters Palermo's radar as the Rosanero outfit banks on him as one of their rising talents. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxOdHRvaWRieHpUNmdrUEFETUdiYUdQN0NHa1lFcms2d0NCXzRNdXBrUDdEWmRRalFiUUlKZ1FiWFEtQ2xvV3p1eTJGNkIzblp3VXlNNWtjS1dPTDJ5TDdVcmZVRXpGQlFKLTFqREtWcThCWTdtQmx3VDlCRzE0R3JjQnRYYUc3M2s?oc=5)

**Giuseppe Ambrosino**
The striker's departure from Napoli sparks debate: many wonder whether it was truly necessary to let him go on the transfer market. [source](https://news.google.?oc=5)

**Gabriel Kulla**
The Sassuolo midfielder continues to impress in youth football and is starting to catch attention for a possible Serie A call-up, with market developments already looming by January. [source](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQNTI1ZzNNUGtBeThmV3g3U3BDNld3WXZNQ2RVakppV3BZLUlSOTBvREk0cndzQ1ZvdFBxUnI2dm8tMlVrSkY1VUZsR2ZKV3ZEU3owa1FzZjYtcV9aNXlHYm9xS3dObTNudUhZaGU4NVdsSWg5NVBaaFJZMmFvendmQ3VJUjN1Zw?oc=5)

Between refereeing rows, tactical absences and hopes for redemption: Italy's young football moves through the folds of everyday competition.
